card.label: H.R. 7148
card.summary: H.R. 7148, titled the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, became Public Law No. 119-75 on February 3, 2026. This federal law provides funding for the Department of Defense, Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and related agencies for fiscal year 2026. It also sets guidelines for the U.S. Sentencing Commission, extends various healthcare, Medicaid, Medicare, and trade programs, introduces pharmacy benefit management transparency rules, and awards a payment to the widow of a late representative.
card.title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026

card.label: H.R. 6703
card.summary: H.R. 6703, titled the "Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act," amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, the Public Health Service Act, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. It sets rules for association health plans, excludes certain stop-loss insurance from health insurance coverage definitions, allows custom health option and individual care expense arrangements, adds oversight and reporting rules for pharmacy benefit managers, and provides appropriations for cost-sharing reduction payments beginning January 1, 2027.
card.title: Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act
